script.text: Yubel was defeated, but he took over Jesse Anderson's body and survived.
Yubel! This is between you and me, so leave Jesse out of this and duel me in your true form!
Leave Jesse out of this? Hahaha! Why would I do that? With this body, I get to force you to fight your friend.
No you don’t. I could just drop my Duel Disk and walk away from this.
And where would you go? The only way out of this dimension is through me, Jaden.
Come on! You love dueling, Jaden. You live for it.
If you're too scared to duel, then you must be too scared to live.
Sooner or later, I'm gonna have to settle the score with Yubel. I don't wanna hurt Jesse, but if I don't put an end to this, who knows who else'll get hurt?
Besides, maybe I can save Jesse.
He dueled to the end, trying to save me. That’s what I gotta do for Jesse. I’ve gotta find a way into his mind and get him to kick Yubel out.
I know that Jesse and his Crystal Beasts can be saved. I have to remember the darkness can be broken!
Ok, Yubel. If you want a duel, then you've got one!
Your time is up, Yubel. Your games end here! I'm gonna take you down!
